Pull request: #314

Tokens: 0 · Cost: $0.0000

Confirmed: branch `bb/relay-115-module-contract-12-12-replace-core-mod-thr_xccpekx99g` exists on origin at commit `225dc62`, matching local HEAD. Nothing new to commit — this branch was already pushed earlier in this conversation and remains up to date.

## Summary

Implements issue #115: replaces the last core `moduleId === ...` behavior branch with a registry projection, and proves the whole module manifest set composes correctly.

- Added an optional `defaultViewType` field to `ModuleManifest`'s database descriptor (`@semprec/module-registry`), projected through `ModuleRegistry.getDatabases()`.
- Declared Journal's `temporal-switcher` default view type on the `systemDatabases` manifest instead of a hardcoded `moduleId === JOURNAL_MODULE_ID` check.
- `seedTenDatabasesInTransaction` now reads the default view type from a `ModuleRegistry` projection; `seedSystem` builds and passes that registry.
- Added `moduleRegistryLoadAll.test.ts`: loads all 7 real manifests from #226/#227 into a single registry, asserting no cross-manifest collisions and correct activation/deactivation behavior of projections.
- Added `moduleRegistryDeactivation.test.ts`: an integration test against a real seeded Postgres database proving a deactivated module's rows remain untouched in storage while its registry projections (databases, view types, migrations) are excluded.
- Confirmed via repo-wide grep that no other `if (moduleId === ...)` branches remain in core consumer code.

Verified: monorepo `tsc` build, `check:boundaries` (dependency-cruiser), and the full test suite (83 unit + 377 integration + 5 e2e tests) all pass, aside from one pre-existing, unrelated flaky concurrency test that is not caused by this change.
